content: {"phoneNote":"In the full page the sticky header row (logo, Pokličite, Navodila za pot) sits over the hero text and hides the headline, and the hero's own 'Pokličite nas' is a thin underlined link, not a real action.","desktopNote":"The hero panel over the photo works, but below it the page loses rhythm: a dead band under the hero, a price grid with an orphan fifth item and an empty right half, and a very tall about section.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Give the hero one real primary button (Pokličite nas) and drop the duplicate call button/link row at the top of the phone page; keep header to logo + menu.","Tighten desktop spacing: remove the empty band below the hero, lay the five prices in one balanced row or a 3+2 grid and cut the vertical padding of the prices and about sections.","Replace the generic street photo in the 'Klasična obrt' section with the barber or the chair/interior and shrink the oversized footer wordmark."],"blockers":["Phone, hero: the fixed header row with 'Pokličite' and 'Navodila za pot' overlaps the hero and covers the headline 'Brivnica v starem jedru Maribora'.","Phone and desktop, top: an empty dark band (about 115px on phone, 57px on desktop) sits above the hero before any content."]}
